blocks.text: Laboratory mein kaam karne wale ko chemicals standard procedures ke mutabiq istemal karne chahiye, un ke khaas khatraat aur mehfooz istemal ke liye zaroori ehtiyaat ko samne rakhte hue. Print kimiyai khatraat ke pictograms Figure 16.2 ke taur par dikhata hai; reagent ke label par hazard pictograms batate hain ke kisi chemical ko kaun si ehtiyaat chahiye.

blocks.caption: Amal mein kimiyai khatraat
rows: Har chemical ke liye standard procedure par chalein
Shuru karne se pehle khatraat pehchanein
Kabhi koi compound ya gas chakhein ya soonghein nahi

blocks.prompt: Koi reagent pehli bar istemal karne se pehle talib-e-ilm us ke khaas khatraat kahan paata hai?
blocks.explanation: Us chemical ke standard procedure mein aur us ke label par lage hazard pictograms mein; talib-e-ilm kaam shuru karne se pehle yeh khatraat aur zaroori ehtiyaat pehchanta hai.

items: Kimiyai khatraat: har chemical ko us ke standard procedure se istemal karein, us ke khaas khatraat aur ehtiyaat jaante hue (hazard pictograms, Figure 16.2).
